prompt: Limbola système ya misala ya ndako esika mosala nyonso ya ndako ebongwanaka na lisano moke, ekokisami na nivo, mbano, mpe mikakatano oyo ekanisamaki te.
prompt_en: Describe a chore system where every household task is turned into a mini-game, complete with levels, rewards, and unexpected challenges.

prompt: Kanisá ete biloko oyo ezalisamá ezali koyemba nzembo ya kolala na mabele liboso butu ekɔta. Maloba nini mpe bililingi nini elingaki kosalela?
prompt_en: Imagine nature singing a lullaby to the earth before the night falls. What words and imagery would it use?

prompt: Etuluku moko ya bato oyo bazali kolukaluka biloko basali mayele ya kopumbwa kati na bonene, kasi bonene mokomoko ezali na likama mingi koleka oyo ya nsuka na ndenge ya mayele mabe. Nini esalaka ete bákende liboso?
prompt_en: A group of explorers has developed technology to jump between dimensions, but each dimension is subtly more dangerous than the last. What keeps them going?

prompt: Komá na ntina na kosala misala na zando epai batekisi batɛkaka biloko ya mokili mpe ya maji, mpe kosala mombongo esɛngaka kaka mbongo te kasi mayele mabe to masese.
prompt_en: Write about running errands in a marketplace where vendors sell both mundane and magical items, and haggling requires not just money but clever tricks or riddles.

prompt: Kokoma masolo kati na moto ya bomoi mpe molimo oyo apesi toli ya bomoi oyo okanisaki te.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between a living person and a ghost who offers unexpected life advice.

prompt: Kanisá naino engumba moko monene oyo ezali na nse ya mabelé oyo ezali na nguya ya ba izini oyo esalaka ete biloko oyo ezali na bomoi ezala makasi. Mikakatano nini bafandi na yango bakutanaka na yango?
prompt_en: Imagine a sprawling underground city powered by bioluminescent plants. What challenges do its inhabitants face?

prompt: Koma email ya koteka na client moko oyo azali kopesa biloko oyo etali yango oyo bakoki kosepela na yango na kotalela biloko oyo asombaki liboso. Monisá ntina oyo biloko yango ebakisaka ndenge oyo basombaka.
prompt_en: Write a sales email to an existing customer offering related products they might be interested in based on previous purchases. Highlight why these products complement their purchase.

prompt: Koma email na moninga oyo osololaki na ye te banda kala. Bokanga bango na makambo oyo ebandaki koleka na vie na bino pe tuna bango ndenge bazali.
prompt_en: Write an email to a friend you haven’t spoken to in a while. Catch them up on what’s been happening in your life and ask them how they’re doing.

prompt: Composer email na professeur moko ya kala kosenga bango bakoma mokanda ya recommandation pona yo. Pesá makambo ya mikemike oyo etali esika yango mpe pesá kopesa makambo mosusu.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former professor asking them to write a recommendation letter for you. Provide details about the position and offer to provide further information.

prompt: Koma email mpo na kopesa longonya na moninga to moninga ya mosala mpo na likambo moko oyo euti kosalema. Monisá esengo na yo mpo na bango mpe pesá maloba ya kolendisa.
prompt_en: Write an email congratulating a friend or colleague on a recent achievement. Express your happiness for them and offer words of encouragement.

prompt: Salá lisolo kati na astronaute mpe mopaya oyo asololaka na lisalisi ya balangi na esika ya maloba.
prompt_en: Create a conversation between an astronaut and an alien who communicates using colors instead of words.

prompt: Koma lisolo moko na ntina ya etuluku ya bilombe minene oyo bazwi pansiɔ oyo babimi na pansiɔ mpo na misio moko ya nsuka.
prompt_en: Write a story about a group of retired superheroes who come out of retirement for one last mission.

prompt: Ekipi moko ya bato oyo bazali kolukaluka bisika yango bamoni sivilizasio moko oyo ebombami oyo bato ya libándá basimbaki te banda bankama ya bambula. Ndenge nini ba interagir na société oyo?
prompt_en: A team of explorers discovers a hidden civilization that has been untouched by the outside world for centuries. How do they interact with this society?

prompt: Koma email officiel na mosali moko ya gouvernement oyo etali likambo moko ya mboka oyo ezali kotungisa yo. Lobá makambo oyo ezali kotungisa yo, pesá makambo oyo ekondimisa yo, mpe pesá ndenge oyo okoki kosilisa yango.
prompt_en: Write a formal email to a government official addressing a local issue that concerns you. State your concerns, provide supporting facts, and suggest possible solutions.

prompt: Komá na ntina na ndako moko epai wapi baaparɛyi nyonso ekoki kosolola. Mokomoko na bango azali na bomoto ekeseni mpe apesaka toli (to komilelalela) ntango yo ozali kosala misala na yo ya mokolo na mokolo.
prompt_en: Write about a home where all the appliances can talk. They each have distinct personalities and give advice (or complaints) while you do your daily chores.

prompt: Kosala email na client moko ya motuya kopesa bango matondo mpo na mombongo na bango oyo ezali kokoba, mpe yebisa bango na ntina ya promotion to offrande moko ya sipesiale.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a valued customer thanking them for their continued business, and inform them about a special promotion or offer.

prompt: Na biro moko ya maji, basali basalelaka bankisi mpo na kotombola mosala na bango mpo na misala ndenge na ndenge. Nini esalemaka soki moto ameli nkisi ya mabe mpo na mosala ya mabe?
prompt_en: In a magical office, employees use potions to boost their productivity for different tasks. What happens when someone takes the wrong potion for the wrong task?

prompt: Koma email na professeur na yo kosenga bolimbisi mpo azangaki kelasi mpo na ba circonstances imprévues. Tuna soki ezali na makambo oyo osengeli kokanga.
prompt_en: Write an email to your professor apologizing for missing a class due to unforeseen circumstances. Ask if there is any material you need to catch up on.

prompt: Na bomoi nsima ya liwa, milimo esambisamaka na kotalela makundoli ya boboto oyo batikaki nsima. Personnage moko a comprendre que bazo sila mbongo.
prompt_en: In the afterlife, souls are judged based on the memories of kindness they left behind. A character realizes they are running out of currency.

prompt: Na ndako moko ya mayemi oyo eyebani mingi, mayemi yango ebandi koloba na mongongo ya nse basekele mpo na bato oyo batalaka yango. Nini ezali nsima ya likambo yango ya kokamwa?
prompt_en: In a renowned art gallery, the paintings begin to whisper secrets about people who view them. What is behind this strange phenomenon?

prompt: Detective moko alamuki na souvenir moko te ya ngonga 48 oyo eleki, kaka mpo amoni ete bazali ba suspects ya liboso na crime moko ya munene. Ndenge nini bamonisaka ete bazali na ngambo te?
prompt_en: A detective wakes up with no memory of the last 48 hours, only to find that they’re the prime suspect in a major crime. How do they prove their innocence?

prompt: Composer email na professeur to mentor ya kala kosenga toli ya carrière. Limbolá na mokuse ezalela na yo ya lelo mpe sɛngá litambwisi mpo na ndenge ya kokende liboso.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former professor or mentor asking for career advice. Briefly explain your current situation and ask for guidance on how to move forward.

prompt: Basusu bakanisaka ete mayemi ezali eloko ya ntina mingi na bato, nzokande basusu bakanisaka ete ezali eloko ya kitoko. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some believe art is an essential part of society, while others think it is a luxury. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Kanisá kofanda na ndako oyo ekoki komipɛtola kasi ezali kobimisa ‘makanisi’ na yango moko mpo na koyeba ndenge bopɛto esengeli kozala. Mikakatano nini ebimaka?
prompt_en: Imagine living in a house that can clean itself but develops its own 'opinions' on what cleanliness should look like. What problems arise?

prompt: Bosala format ya liste ya misala ya bokeli mpe ya momesano te oyo ebongoli misala ya mokolo na mokolo na lisano. Mibeko ezali nini, mpe ndenge nini etindaka yo?
prompt_en: Invent a creative and unusual to-do list format that turns daily chores into a game. What are the rules, and how do they motivate you?

prompt: Lobelá mokili oyo bato ya sivilizasio bafandaka na bisanga oyo ezali kopumbwapumbwa na likoló, mpe biloko oyo ezali na kati ezali komema na nzela ya réseau ya ba ballons minene.
prompt_en: Describe a world where civilizations live on floating islands in the sky, and resources are transported through a network of giant balloons.

prompt: Basusu balobaka ete esengeli kosala ekzamɛ ya banyama mpo na bolukiluki ya minganga, nzokande basusu bakanisaka ete esengeli kopekisa yango. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some argue that animal testing for medical research is necessary, while others believe it should be banned. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Na mokili ya tekiniki ya likolo epai kuna kopema ezali malamu na siansi, limbolá momeseno ya mopɛpɛ ya moto na butu na kosaleláká bisaleli mpe mayele ya mikolo mizali koya.
prompt_en: In a high-tech world where relaxation is scientifically optimized, describe a person’s nightly wind-down routine using futuristic tools and methods.

prompt: Etuluku moko ya ba pirates ya likoló bazali kotambola na bamasuwa ya mpɛpɔ na bisanga oyo ezali kopumbwapumbwa mpe na bingumba ya likoló mpo na koluka eloko moko ya motuya ya masapo oyo ebombami na mapata.
prompt_en: A band of sky pirates navigates airships through floating islands and sky cities in search of a legendary treasure hidden in the clouds.

prompt: Mbongwana ya klima ezali na bopusi monene likoló na mokili na biso. Okanisi ete nini ezali bantina minene ya mbongwana ya klima, mpe bopusi nini ekoki kozala na yango likoló na ezingelo?
prompt_en: Climate change is having a significant impact on our planet. What do you think are the main causes of climate change, and what are its potential effects on the environment?

prompt: Bapesi yo liste ya biloko ya kolia oyo ezali na biloko oyo emonani lokola ezali te. Ntango ozali kolukaluka, omoni ete eloko mokomoko ezali elembo oyo ememaka na eloko moko ya monene koleka.
prompt_en: You are given a grocery list with items that don't seem to exist. As you search, you discover that each item is a clue leading to something much bigger.

prompt: Koma email na professeur moko kotuna na ntina ya mabaku ya bolukiluki oyo ekoki kozala. Monisá makambo oyo osepelaka na yango mpe limbolá ntina oyo okolinga kosala elongo na bango.
prompt_en: Write an email to a professor inquiring about potential research opportunities. Highlight your interests and explain why you’d like to work with them.

prompt: Koma email ya malili na client potentiel oyo azali kolakisa entreprise na yo mpe kopesa ba services na yo. Monisá makambo ya ntina oyo ozali kosala mpe limbolá ndenge oyo okoki kosalisa mombongo na bango.
prompt_en: Write a cold email to a potential client introducing your company and offering your services. Highlight your key strengths and explain how you can help their business.

prompt: Bozali ya mibembo ya mikili mingi emati mingi. Lobela matomba mpe mabe mpo na ba touristes mpe mikili oyo ekoyamba bango.
prompt_en: The availability of international travel has increased significantly. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages for tourists and host countries.

prompt: Salá lisolo epai wapi kobongisa bilei ya mokolo na mokolo ebongwanaka na aventure culinaire —ingrédient moko na moko euti na mabele ya magie mpe esengaka kosimbama na ndenge ya sipesiale.
prompt_en: Create a story where daily meal prepping turns into a culinary adventure—each ingredient comes from a magical land and requires special handling.

prompt: Salá email mpo na kosɛnga bázongisa to bábongola biloko oyo osombi na nzela ya Internet. Tyá nimero na yo ya komande mpe ntina oyo ozongisaki yango.
prompt_en: Compose an email to request a return or exchange for a product you purchased online. Include your order number and reason for the return.

prompt: Na mikolo mizali koya oyo AI etambwisaka, ekateli ya nsuka oyo bato bapesameli nzela ya kozwa ezali bokundoli nini balingi kobatela mpo na libela.
prompt_en: In a future controlled by AI, the last decision humans are allowed to make is which memory they want to preserve for eternity.

prompt: Otele moko ebimaka na ndenge ya kobombama na bisika ndenge na ndenge na mokili mobimba, kasi kaka na butu. Soki ntɔngɔ ekómi, elimwaka. Secret na yango eza nini?
prompt_en: A hotel mysteriously appears in different locations around the world, but only at night. Once morning comes, it vanishes. What’s its secret?

prompt: Mondialisation ezali komema na kobungisa identité culturelle. Na meko nini ondimi to ondimi te? Meko nini ekoki kozwama mpo na kobatela mimeseno ya mboka?
prompt_en: Globalization is leading to the loss of cultural identity. To what extent do you agree or disagree? What measures can be taken to preserve local cultures?

prompt: Koma email na professeur na yo kosenga prolongation ya devoir. Limbolá ezalela na yo mpe pesá ntango oyo ebongi mpo na ntango oyo okoki kosilisa mosala yango.
prompt_en: Write an email to your professor requesting an extension for an assignment. Explain your situation and provide a reasonable timeline for when you can complete the work.

prompt: Ezali boni soki balangi nyonso oyo ezali na mokili ebandaki kolimwa mokomoko? Limbolá nini esalemaka ntango etikali kaka langi moko.
prompt_en: What if all the colors in the world started disappearing one by one? Describe what happens when there's only one color left.

prompt: Etuluku moko ya bato ya siansi bamoni ete bandoto ezali komona mwa moke makambo oyo ekokani na yango. Ndenge nini yango ebongoli bososoli na biso ya makanisi?
prompt_en: A group of scientists discovers that dreams are glimpses into parallel realities. How does this change our understanding of the mind?

prompt: Koma email mpo na kolanda interview ya mosala oyo osalaki il y a deux semaines. Monisá ete ozali kokoba kosepela na esika yango, pesa matɔndi na moto oyo azali kotuna ye mituna mpo na ntango na ye, mpe sɛngá makambo ya sika.
prompt_en: Write an email to follow up on a job interview you had two weeks ago. Express your continued interest in the position, thank the interviewer for their time, and ask for updates.

prompt: Basusu bandimaka ete koyekola na nzela ya Internet ezali malamu koleka boyekoli ya bonkɔkɔ, nzokande basusu balobaka ete koyekola na kelasi ezali naino na ntina mingi. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some believe online learning is more effective than traditional learning, while others argue classroom learning is still crucial. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Koleka ya bato ezali kokóma likambo oyo ezali kotungisa mingi na bingumba mingi. Nini ezali bantina ya kolekisa bato, mpe bopusi nini ezali na bomoi ya bingumba?
prompt_en: Overpopulation is becoming a serious concern in many cities. What are the causes of overpopulation, and what are the effects on urban life?

prompt: Kanisa na makanisi société oyo magie mpe technologie esangani sans soudure. Ndenge nini bato basalelaka nguya yango na bomoi na bango ya mokolo na mokolo?
prompt_en: Envision a society where magic and technology are seamlessly integrated. How do people use these powers in their daily lives?

prompt: Na esobe oyo etondi na mipɛpɛ makasi ya zɛlo mpe bikelamu oyo ebombami, bato oyo basalaka aventure babundaka na momekano ya mbangu oyo esalemaka mbula na mbula mpo na kozwa mbano oyo emonanaka mingi te.
prompt_en: In a desert filled with dangerous sandstorms and hidden creatures, adventurers compete in an annual race for a rare prize.

prompt: Komá email na moninga ya motema to moto ya libota oyo azali kokabola nsango ya kosepelisa. Yebisá bango makambo mikemike mpe ndenge oyo ozali koyoka mpo na yango.
prompt_en: Write an email to a close friend or family member sharing exciting news. Tell them the details and how you’re feeling about it.

prompt: Komá email na departema ya service clientèle ya compagnie moko mpo na ko répondre na expérience ya mabe oyo ozalaki na yango na service na bango. Limbolá mokakatano yango mpe yebisá ndenge oyo okolinga ete esilisa yango.
prompt_en: Write an email to a company’s customer service department to address a poor experience you had with their service. Explain the problem and suggest how you would like it resolved.

prompt: Bokonzi moko oyo bakanisaki ete ebungaki na lisolo ya bato ezwami lisusu, kasi bato na yango bakómi mibange te banda bikeke mingi. Nini ekómelaki bango?
prompt_en: A kingdom thought to be lost in history is rediscovered, but its people haven’t aged in centuries. What happened to them?

prompt: Na mokili oyo ba souvenirs ekoki koyiba, limbolá bomoi ya moyibi ya ba souvenirs oyo abandi kobungisa identité na bango moko.
prompt_en: In a world where memories can be stolen, describe the life of a memory thief who begins to lose track of their own identity.

prompt: Kanisa kelasi ya yoga oyo esalemaka na studio moko ya enchanté epai gravité ebalukaka, ntango egumbamaka, mpe ba poses ezuaka ba effets ya magie.
prompt_en: Imagine a yoga class that takes place in an enchanted studio where gravity shifts, time bends, and poses take on magical effects.

prompt: Salá lisolo zingazinga ya eloko moko ya kala oyo, ntango esimbami, elakisaka moto oyo azali na yango mwa moke avenire na bango, kasi kaka na boumeli ya segɔnde 10.
prompt_en: Create a narrative around an ancient artifact that, when touched, shows the holder a glimpse of their future, but only for 10 seconds.

prompt: Application moko ya sika elobi ete esalaka lokola ‘mokolo ya mosala ya kokoka’ na kotalela mimeseno mpe makambo oyo moto alingaka. Komá na ntina na moto oyo amekaka yango, kaka mpo na komona ete ezali makasi mingi koleka ndenge bakanisaki.
prompt_en: A new app claims to simulate the ‘perfect workday’ based on an individual’s habits and preferences. Write about someone who tries it, only to discover it's far more intense than they expected.

prompt: Bato moko ya masuwa bakangami na esanga moko ya kobombama oyo ebongwanaka ntango nyonso ndenge na yango mpe ebombaka basekele ya kala.
prompt_en: A crew gets stranded on a mysterious island that constantly shifts its landscape and hides ancient secrets.

prompt: Lobelá mobembo moko oyo basalaki na eteni ya mozindo mpenza ya mbu, epai bakuti likambo moko oyo bakanisaki te​—engumba moko ya kala oyo bikelamu oyo eyebani te bakɛngɛli.
prompt_en: Describe an expedition to the deepest part of the ocean, where they find something unexpected—an ancient city guarded by unknown creatures.

prompt: Koma email ya bolandi na client potentiel oyo alakisaki intérêt na produit na yo. Kundwelá bango matomba mpe yebisa bango ete okoyanola na mituna nyonso.
prompt_en: Write a follow-up email to a potential client who expressed interest in your product. Remind them of the benefits and offer to answer any questions.

prompt: Lobelá mokolo moko na Mabelé epai nguya ya kobenda biloko ebalukaka na mbalakaka na boumeli ya mwa bangonga. Bato mpe banyama basalaka ndenge nini?
prompt_en: Describe a day on Earth where gravity suddenly reverses for a few hours. How do people and animals react?

prompt: Na engumba oyo ezali na mikolo ezali koya, ebongiseli ya métro ezali labyrinthe oyo ezali kobongwana ntango nyonso. Koma na ntina ya mobembo ya routine ya moto na nzela ya système oyo imprévisible.
prompt_en: In a futuristic city, the subway system is an ever-changing maze. Write about someone's routine commute through this unpredictable system.

prompt: Likita moko esalemaka kati na bikelamu ndenge na ndenge ya bapaya mpo na kosala boyokani ya kimya mpo na bato nyonso. Ndenge nini balongaka mikakatano ya monɔkɔ mpe ya mimeseno?
prompt_en: A conference is held between various alien species to form a universal peace treaty. How do they overcome language and cultural barriers?

prompt: Composer email na baninga na yo ya kelasi oyo bazali ko coordonner projet ya groupe. Pesá misala, pesá mikolo ya nsuka, mpe pesá ngonga ya likita mpo na kolobela bokoli.
prompt_en: Compose an email to your classmates coordinating a group project. Assign tasks, set deadlines, and suggest a meeting time to discuss progress.

prompt: Mikóló mingi bazali naino na mayele ya moboko ya nimero te na mokili ya lelo. Nini ezali bantina oyo ezali sima ya likambo oyo, mpe nini ekoki kosalema mpo na kobongisa boyebi ya kotanga mpe kokoma na nimero?
prompt_en: Many adults still do not have basic digital skills in today's world. What are the reasons behind this, and what can be done to improve digital literacy?

prompt: Na bisika mingi ya mokili, motángo ya bato oyo bazali kotánga mikanda ekiti mpenza. Nini ezali bantina ya bokiti yango, mpe mbuma nini ezali kobimisa mpo na bato?
prompt_en: In many parts of the world, the number of people reading books has decreased significantly. What are the reasons for this decline, and what are the consequences for society?

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya mosungi ya moto ye moko ya AI oyo abandi kolimbola misala na ndenge ya bokeli mpe azali kosala misala oyo ezali na litomba mpe oyo ekoki kokanisama te.
prompt_en: Write about an AI personal assistant that starts to interpret tasks creatively and takes actions that are both helpful and wildly unpredictable.

prompt: Komá na ntina na planɛti moko oyo esalemaki na lolenge moko ya bikelamu oyo ekómi na mayele mingi kasi esundolami. Bafandi ya sika bamoni nini mpo na ntina na yango ya solosolo?
prompt_en: Write about a planet that was engineered by an advanced species but has been abandoned. What do the new inhabitants discover about its true purpose?

prompt: Composer email oyo eko confirmer abonné ya sika na bulletin ya sango ya entreprise na yo. Matɔndi bango mpo na kosala abonnément, yebisa bango nini basengeli kozela, mpe kotia libiangi ya kosala.
prompt_en: Compose an email confirming a new subscriber to your company’s newsletter. Thank them for subscribing, tell them what to expect, and include a call to action.

prompt: Composer email ya marketing oyo ekosakola lancement ya produit ya sika. Tyá makambo mosusu oyo etali makambo oyo ezali na biloko yango, matomba na yango, mpe makambo nyonso ya sipesiale oyo elobelaka to oyo ekitisaka mbongo.
prompt_en: Compose a marketing email announcing the launch of a new product. Include details about the product’s features, benefits, and any special promotions or discounts.

prompt: Ekuke moko ya kobombama ebimi na zamba oyo ememaka na bokonzi ya fae. Bato oyo basalaka mibembo ya liboso bazwaka nini na ngámbo mosusu?
prompt_en: A mysterious door appears in the forest that leads to the fae realm. What do the first travelers find on the other side?

prompt: Na bingumba mingi ya minene, kobebisa mopɛpɛ mpe mai ezali likambo ya ntina mingi. Nini ezali kobimisa mikakatano yango, mpe bibongiseli nini ekoki kozwama mpo na kobongisa makambo?
prompt_en: In many large cities, air and water pollution is a significant issue. What are the causes of these problems, and what measures can be taken to improve the situation?

prompt: Kokoma poeme esika saison moko na moko ezali personifiée mpe bamipesa na masolo na ntina ya cycle ya vie.
prompt_en: Write a poem where each season is personified and they engage in a conversation about the cycle of life.

prompt: Salá molɔngɔ ya ba haiku oyo mokomoko na yango ezali komonisa souvenir fragmenté ya bolingo oyo babosani.
prompt_en: Create a series of haikus that each represent a fragmented memory of a forgotten love.

prompt: Na bambula oyo euti koleka, mosala ya mosika ekómi mingi. Lobela matomba mpe mabe ya mosala ya mosika.
prompt_en: In recent years, remote work has become more common. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of remote work.

prompt: Lobelá engumba oyo ndako mpe balabala nyonso ezali na bomoi, ezali na makanisi mpe mayoki na yango. Ndenge nini bafandi yango bafandaka elongo na bandako na bango ya kofanda?
prompt_en: Describe a city where every building and street is alive, with its own thoughts and feelings. How do the inhabitants coexist with their living homes?

prompt: Mopaya moko oyo alati maskɛ azali kokoba kobima na bisika ndenge na ndenge ya mabe kasi emonani ata moke te ete azali na boyokani na likambo yango. Bazali banani, mpe bayebi nini?
prompt_en: A masked stranger keeps appearing at various crime scenes but never seems to be connected to the crime. Who are they, and what do they know?

prompt: Kanisá ete mbala nyonso oyo ozali kosala ngalasisi, bamemaka yo na esika mosusu oyo makasi na yo ya nzoto ezali na bopusi likoló na mokili oyo ezali zingazinga na yo. Limbolá ntango moko ya kosala ngalasisi.
prompt_en: Imagine that every time you work out, you are transported to an alternate reality where your physical strength affects the world around you. Describe one workout session.

prompt: Bato mosusu bakanisaka ete esengeli kosilisa mikakatano ya ezingelo na mokili mobimba, nzokande basusu bakanisaka ete esengeli kosilisa yango na mboka. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some people believe environmental problems should be solved globally, while others think they should be tackled locally. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Kanisá mokili oyo mayoki mazali kotyama na milangi mpe kotɛkama. Ndenge nini yango ekobongola boyokani ya bato mpe bato?
prompt_en: Imagine a world where emotions are bottled and sold. How would this change human interactions and society?

prompt: Na mwa mboka moko, moi elimwaka na mbalakaka mpe ezalaka ntango nyonso na midi ya butu. Moto moko te akoki kolongwa na engumba yango, mpe bikelamu ya kokamwa ebandi kobima na molili.
prompt_en: In a small town, the sun suddenly disappears and it’s always midnight. No one can leave the town, and strange creatures begin to emerge from the darkness.

prompt: Kanisa biro esika mosali nyonso azali komonisa mayoki ekeseni (ndakisa, esengo, nkanda, zuwa). Ndenge nini batambolaka na misala mpe makita ya mokolo na mokolo?
prompt_en: Imagine an office where every employee represents a different emotion (e.g., joy, anger, envy). How do they navigate daily tasks and meetings?

prompt: Kanisá naino magazini moko ya biloko ya kolya oyo ekosalema na mikolo ezali koya epai barobo oyo etambwisami na AI esalisaka basombi, kasi bazali na makanisi na bango moko. Ndenge nini yango ezali na bopusi likoló na likambo oyo moto akoki kosomba?
prompt_en: Imagine a futuristic grocery store where AI-driven robots assist shoppers, but they have a mind of their own. How does this affect the shopping experience?

prompt: Bapesi yo mokumba ya kosomba biloko na kobombana, kasi bamagazini oyo batindi yo ezali eloko nyonso kasi ya momeseno —mokomoko na yango ezali na sekele moko oyo esengeli kobimisama.
prompt_en: You are tasked with a mystery shopping job, but the stores you're sent to are anything but ordinary—each one has a secret that needs to be uncovered.

prompt: Basusu bakanisaka ete baboti nde basengeli kozala kaka na mokumba ya kobɔkɔla bana, nzokande basusu bakanisaka ete guvɛrnema esengeli kosala mosala yango. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some believe parents should be solely responsible for raising children, while others think the government should play a role. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Osengeli kosala programɛ ya likita elongo na moninga ya mosala mpo na kolobela ndenge mosala moko ezali kokende liboso. Komá email ya bonkonde mpo na kosɛnga ntango oyo ebongi mpo na likita mpe pesá plan mokuse.
prompt_en: You need to schedule a meeting with a colleague to discuss the progress of a project. Write a polite email requesting a suitable time for the meeting and provide a brief outline.

prompt: Na mikolo mizali koya mosika, etando etondi na biloko ya mabe ya sivilizasio ya mobembo na likoló oyo babosani banda kala. Lobelá bomoi ya moto oyo azali kobwaka biloko na kati ya bitika yango.
prompt_en: In the far future, space is littered with the debris of long-forgotten spacefaring civilizations. Describe a scavenger's life among these ruins.

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya eteni ya tekiniki (telephone, ordinateur portable, etc.) oyo ekomi haunted na entite malevolent. Ndenge nini e manipuler nkolo na yango?
prompt_en: Write about a piece of technology (phone, laptop, etc.) that becomes haunted by a malevolent entity. How does it manipulate its owner?

prompt: Bokóli ya tekiniki ebongoli ndenge oyo bato basololaka. Matomba mpe mabe nini ezali na bokoli oyo?
prompt_en: Technological advancements have changed how people communicate. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development?

prompt: Na mikili mingi, mwayene ya kilo ya bato ezali se kobakisama, nzokande kolɔngɔnɔ ya nzoto mpe nzoto kolɔngɔnɔ ezali kokita. Nini ezali bantina mpe ba solutions possibles ya problème oyo?
prompt_en: In many countries, the average weight of people is increasing, while health and fitness levels are decreasing. What are the causes and possible solutions to this problem?

prompt: Teleportation ezali lolenge ya transport oyo emonanaka mingi, kasi glitch esalaka ete bato oyo bakendaka na mosala bákangama mpo na mwa ntango kati na bisika. Lobelá ndenge oyo bato bazali kosilisa mokakatano yango ya mokolo na mokolo.
prompt_en: Teleportation is the most common form of transportation, but a glitch causes commuters to temporarily get stuck between locations. Describe how people handle this daily inconvenience.

prompt: Limbolá mobembo ya mokolo na mokolo na engumba ya makanisi mpamba oyo etondi na bikelamu ya maji, epai kuna mituka ya bato nyonso ezali na bashario oyo esalemi na mayele mabe, bikelamu oyo epumbwaka, to baporte.
prompt_en: Describe a daily commute in a fantasy city filled with magical creatures, where public transportation includes enchanted carriages, flying creatures, or portals.

prompt: Basusu bakanisaka ete kozala na bokatikati kati na mosala mpe bomoi ezali mpasi mingi lelo koleka na ntango ya kala. Na meko nini ondimi to ondimi te maloba oyo?
prompt_en: Some believe achieving work-life balance is more difficult today than in the past. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

prompt: Kanisa lisolo mosusu epai wapi Leonardo da Vinci asilisaki masini ya ngonga oyo ezalaki kosala. Nini elingaki kosalema soki bamoni yango na mikolo na biso?
prompt_en: Imagine an alternate history where Leonardo da Vinci completed a working time machine. What would happen if it were discovered in modern times?

prompt: Composer email na directeur na yo kosenga bolimbisi pona kozanga date limite ya projet. Limbolá ntina ya retard, mpe lobá matambe na yo mpo na kosala ete esalema lisusu te.
prompt_en: Compose an email to your manager apologizing for missing a project deadline. Explain the reason for the delay, and outline your steps to ensure it won’t happen again.

prompt: Kosomba biloko na nzela ya Internet ekómi kosepela mingi na bambula oyo euti koleka. Nini ezali bantina ya likambo oyo, mpe bopusi nini ezali na yango likoló na mimbongo ya mboka?
prompt_en: Online shopping has become increasingly popular in recent years. What are the reasons for this trend, and what impact does it have on local businesses?

prompt: Bosala routine ya bopeto ya mokolo na mokolo na mokili oyo mokolo na mokolo ememaka obstacle magique ekeseni, lokola mputulu enchanté to bisaleli ya bopeto ya mabe.
prompt_en: Invent a daily cleaning routine in a world where every day brings a different magical obstacle, like enchanted dust or mischievous cleaning tools.

prompt: Kosala poème oyo ememaka motángi na série ya ba paysages ya ndoto surréaliste, kosangisa réalité na imagination.
prompt_en: Compose a poem that takes the reader through a series of surreal dreamscapes, blending reality and imagination.

prompt: Koma lisolo moko oyo elobeli société oyo masini moko emonisaka motuya ya bizaleli malamu ya moto. Nini esalemaka ntango moto oyo azali na bapwɛ́ moke ya bizaleli malamu azali kotya ntembe na ebongiseli yango?
prompt_en: Write a story about a society where a machine determines a person's moral worth. What happens when someone with a low moral score challenges the system?

prompt: Bobongola mokolo ya mokili ya kopota mbangu na misala na boluki ya épique, na arrêt moko na moko oyo ezali kolakisa mokakatano moko oyo ekeseni na mosusu (ndakisa, kozwa biloko oyo emonanaka mingi te, kosilisa ba puzzles, mpe bongo na bongo).
prompt_en: Turn a mundane day of running errands into an epic quest, with each stop presenting a unique challenge (e.g., retrieving rare ingredients, solving puzzles, etc.).

prompt: Bosala lisolo kati na AI mpe mokeli na yango, epai AI ezali kotya ntembe na ntina ya bozali na yango.
prompt_en: Craft a conversation between an AI and its creator, where the AI questions the purpose of its existence.

prompt: Kokoma dialogue entre deux courtiers oyo bazali kosala complot ya kokweyisa mokonzi moko ya bolingo, kasi na torsion que moko na bango azali na agenda cachée.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between two courtiers conspiring to overthrow a beloved monarch, but with a twist that one of them has a hidden agenda.

prompt: Lobelá mpokwa moko ya momeseno oyo olekisaka elongo na nyama ya ndako ya maji oyo ezali na likoki ya kobongola lolenge na yango mpo ekokana na ezalela ya nkolo na yango.
prompt_en: Describe a routine evening spent with a magical pet that has the ability to change its form to match the owner's mood.

prompt: Omoni charge moko ya mabe na facture na yo ya sanza. Koma email na departema ya facturation kolimbola likambo mpe kosenga correction.
prompt_en: You’ve noticed an incorrect charge on your monthly bill. Write an email to the billing department explaining the issue and asking for a correction.

prompt: Koma email mpo na kopesa matondo na moto ya libota to moninga mpo na likabo oyo bapesaki yo. Zalá na bosikisiki mpo na nini osepelaka na likabo yango mpe ndenge oyo okani kosalela yango.
prompt_en: Write an email thanking a family member or friend for a gift they gave you. Be specific about why you appreciate the gift and how you plan to use it.

prompt: Na mikolo mizali koya mosika te, bososoli ekoki kopesama na nzoto ndenge na ndenge. Nini esalemaka ntango moto akɔti na nzoto ya mayele mpe alingi kozonga na lolenge na ye ya ebandeli?
prompt_en: In the near future, consciousness can be transferred to different bodies. What happens when someone transfers into an artificial body and wants to return to their original form?

prompt: Kokoma dialogue entre détective na cerebre criminelle oyo bazali baninga ya bomwana na kobombana.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between a detective and a criminal mastermind who are secretly childhood friends.

prompt: Salá moto oyo elili na ye ekómi na bomoi mpe azali kosala lokola moninga na bango ya mabe.
prompt_en: Create a character whose shadow has come to life and acts as their mischievous counterpart.

prompt: Koma email na bureau ya admissions ya université moko kosenga ba informations na programme moko ya sikisiki. Tuna na ntina ya ndenge ya kosenga, mikolo ya suka, etc.
prompt_en: Write an email to the admissions office of a university requesting information about a specific program. Ask about the application process, deadlines, etc.

prompt: Kozala monene mingi ezali kokóma mokakatano monene na mikili mingi. Nini ezali bantina ya likambo yango, mpe bibongiseli nini bikoki kozwama mpo na kosilisa yango?
prompt_en: Obesity is becoming a serious problem in many countries. What are the causes of this issue, and what measures could be taken to address it?

prompt: Tracker na yo ya fitness ebandi kopesa yo ba conseils personnalisés, presque psychiques. Ndenge nini ebongoli routine na yo, mpe agenda na yango oyo ebombami ezali nini?
prompt_en: Your fitness tracker starts giving you personalized, almost psychic advice. How does it transform your routine, and what’s its hidden agenda?

prompt: Kokoma lisolo mokuse uta na makanisi ya masuwa ya spatial oyo ezali na mayoki oyo ezali na mposa makasi ya boninga kasi ekangami na planète oyo bato bafandi te.
prompt_en: Write a short story from the perspective of a sentient spaceship that longs for companionship but is stuck on an uninhabited planet.

prompt: Koma email na mokambi na yo kosenga makanisi na rapport moko ya sika oyo otindaki. Monisá mposa na yo ya kobongisa mosala na yo mpe sɛngá makanisi ya sikisiki.
prompt_en: Write an email to your supervisor asking for feedback on a recent report you submitted. Express your interest in improving your work and ask for specific suggestions.

prompt: Bosala mokili esika liziba se moko ya mayi ezali oasis mystique oyo etambolaka sanza na sanza, ememaka na migration constante ya ba habitants nionso.
prompt_en: Create a world where the only source of water is a mystical oasis that moves every month, leading to constant migration of all inhabitants.

prompt: Komá na ntina na moto oyo kozanga koyeba, atye sinyatili na kontra na nganga-nkisi moko ya nguya mpe sikoyo asengeli kokokisa mosala moko oyo ekoki kosalema te.
prompt_en: Write about a person who unknowingly signs a contract with a powerful sorcerer and now must fulfill a near-impossible task.

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya moto oyo azali moto ya nsuka na lolenge na bango oyo azali kofanda na mokili oyo esili kokende liboso kozanga bango.
prompt_en: Write about a character who is the last of their kind living in a world that has moved on without them.

prompt: Limbola routine ya mosala ya mosika, kasi na esika ya kosala uta na ndako, personnage azali kosala uta na bisika ndenge na ndenge ya kokamwa (lokola bisanga oyo ezali kopumbwapumbwa to bazamba ya enchanté).
prompt_en: Describe a remote work routine, but instead of working from home, the character is working from different fantastical locations (like floating islands or enchanted forests).

prompt: Basusu bakanisaka ete ba médias sociaux ezali na bopusi malamu likoló na bato, nzokande basusu bakanisaka ete ezali na bopusi mabe. Lobela makanisi nyonso mibale mpe pesá makanisi na yo.
prompt_en: Some believe social media has a positive influence on society, while others think it has a negative impact. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Mosali ya bana-popi azali kosala bana-popi oyo ezali lokola bomoi, kasi nsima ya kolimwa na ye na ndenge ya kobombama, bana-popi yango ebandi kosala lokola nde bazali na bomoi, mokomoko na bango azali na mikano ya mabe.
prompt_en: A dollmaker creates lifelike dolls, but after his mysterious disappearance, the dolls begin to act as if they are alive, each with sinister intentions.

prompt: Bingumba mingi ezali kotya mbongo na ba systèmes ya transport public mpo na kokitisa congestion ya mituka. Lobela matomba mpe mabe ya investissement oyo.
prompt_en: Many cities are investing in public transportation systems to reduce traffic congestion. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this investment.

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya mopanzi sango moko oyo azali kosala couverture ya likambo moko ya monene ya lisolo oyo abongoli na mbalakaka mbano na yango na lapolo moko.
prompt_en: Write about a journalist covering a major historical event who accidentally alters its outcome with a single report.

prompt: Mondialisation ememi matomba mingi, kasi mpe ba impacts négatifs na ba aspects mosusu ya société. Nini ezali bantina ya mokili mobimba, mpe ndenge nini yango esali ete mokili mobimba?
prompt_en: Globalization has brought many benefits, but also negative impacts on certain aspects of society. What are the causes of globalization, and how has it affected the world?

prompt: Limbolá lisolo ya etuluku moko ya botɛmɛli na ntango ya boyangeli ya konyokola bato na lisolo ya bato, mpe mikakatano ya bizaleli malamu oyo bakutanaka na yango mpo na kobika.
prompt_en: Describe the story of a resistance group during an oppressive regime in history, and the moral dilemmas they face to survive.

prompt: Salá lisolo moko oyo elobeli moto oyo azali koluka kotika momeseno moko ya mabe ya mokili (lokola kozongisa makambo nsima to kolya mwa bilei mingi) na kosaleláká mayele oyo ezali ya momeseno te to ya maji.
prompt_en: Create a story about someone trying to break a mundane bad habit (like procrastination or excessive snacking) using unconventional or magical methods.

prompt: Salá lisolo moko oyo elobeli bibliotɛkɛ oyo ezali na buku nyonso oyo ekomamaki mpe buku nyonso oyo ekokaki kokomama.
prompt_en: Create a story about a library that contains every book ever written and every book that could ever be written.

prompt: Mbala nyonso oyo ozali kozwa bisi mpo na kokende mosala, ozali komona version mosusu ya mobembo moko na univers parallèle. Mitindo nini to mbongwana nini obandi komona?
prompt_en: Every time you take the bus to work, you experience a different version of the same commute in a parallel universe. What patterns or changes do you begin to notice?

prompt: Koma mokolo moko na vie ya mutu hyper-organisé oyo a planifier minute nionso ya mokolo na bango. Nini esalemaka ntango makambo ebandi kokende kozanga programɛ?
prompt_en: Write about a day in the life of a hyper-organized person who plans every minute of their day. What happens when things start to go off-schedule?

prompt: Limbola ezaleli moko oyo akoki kokufa te kasi ayokaka mwa mpasi nyonso mpo na bampota na bango. Ndenge nini balongaka kozala wana?
prompt_en: Describe a character who cannot die but feels every bit of pain from their injuries. How do they cope with this existence?

prompt: Na bingumba mingi, bato oyo bazangi ndako ezali se kobakisama. Nini ezali bantina ya bokóli wana, mpe nini ekoki kosalema mpo na kokitisa mokakatano?
prompt_en: In many urban areas, homelessness is on the rise. What are the reasons for this increase, and what can be done to reduce the problem?

prompt: Kanisá ete ozali na nguya monene oyo epesaka yo nzela ya kopema na boumeli ya miniti 10 ngonga nyonso. Ndenge nini okɔtisaka yango na momeseno na yo ya mokolo na mokolo?
prompt_en: Imagine you have a superpower that allows you to pause time for 10 minutes every hour. How do you incorporate this into your daily routine?

prompt: Bosala lolenge ya kosala journal oyo ekeseni na mosusu mpo na kokanisa na ntina ya makambo ya mokolo, kosalelaka masengi oyo etali mingi bantango mike ya botondi, ya bokeli, to ya komimona.
prompt_en: Invent a unique journaling method for reflecting on the day’s events, using prompts that focus on small moments of gratitude, creativity, or self-discovery.

prompt: Bato mingi bazali kolongwa na bamboka mpe kokende na bingumba. Lobelá matomba mpe mabe ya momeseno yango.
prompt_en: More people are moving from rural areas to cities. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya moto oyo azali kosala komanyola na bisika oyo ezali ya momesano te (ndakisa, likolo ya ndako ya likoló, na nse ya mbu, na zamba ya monene) mpo na komitya na katikati nsima ya mokolo molai.
prompt_en: Write about someone who practices meditation in the most unusual of places (e.g., atop a skyscraper, under the sea, in a dense forest) to center themselves after a long day.

prompt: Kosala email na patron ya kala oyo azali kosenga kosalela bango lokola référence mpo na demande ya sika ya mosala. Na bonkonde nyonso, sɛngá ndingisa na bango mpe pesá bango matɔndi mpo na lisungi na bango.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former employer requesting to use them as a reference for a new job application. Politely ask for their permission and thank them for their support.

prompt: Limbola routine futuriste ya tongo esika nionso ezali automatisé mpe optimisé mpo na productivité maximale. Mikakatano nini ya mbalakaka ebimaka?
prompt_en: Describe a futuristic morning routine where everything is automated and optimized for maximum productivity. What unexpected challenges arise?

prompt: Komá poɛmi oyo ezali kokanga rythme mpe makɛlɛlɛ ya engumba oyo ezali na mobulu lokola nde ezali symphonie.
prompt_en: Write a poem that captures the rhythm and sounds of a bustling city as if it were a symphony.

prompt: Limbola ba aventures ya voyageur ya temps oyo na mbalakaka akangami na univers parallèle esika ba événements historiques ezui tournant drastiquement différent.
prompt_en: Describe the adventures of a time traveler who accidentally gets stuck in a parallel universe where historical events have taken a drastically different turn.

prompt: Na mikili mingi, bilenge bazali kobunda mpo na koluka mosala. Nini ezali bantina ya likambo oyo, mpe nini okoki kopesa makanisi mpo na kosilisa yango?
prompt_en: In many countries, young people struggle to find employment. What are the causes of this issue, and what solutions can you suggest?

prompt: Limbola mokili moko ya sima ya apocalyptique oyo emitongaki lisusu na utopie, kasi na basekele ya nsé oyo ezali kotya kimia na yango na likama.
prompt_en: Describe a post-apocalyptic world that has rebuilt itself into a utopia, but with underlying secrets that threaten its peace.

prompt: Bosala personnage oyo kala azalaki héros mais akomi vilain en raison ya incompréhension moko ya mawa.
prompt_en: Create a character who was once a hero but has become a villain due to a tragic misunderstanding.

prompt: Na mikili misusu, mikumba ya mibali na basi ezali kobongwana, nzokande na mikili misusu, mikumba ya bonkoko ezali kaka. Ondimi ete mikumba ya mibali na basi ezali kobongwana? Yango ezali na bopusi nini likoló na bato?
prompt_en: In some countries, gender roles are changing, while in others, traditional roles persist. Do you agree gender roles are changing? What impact is this having on society?

prompt: Kanisá bokonzi oyo mayoki etambwisaka ntango. Limbola mokolo moko na bomoi ya mwana mboka oyo afandaka kuna.
prompt_en: Imagine a kingdom where emotions control the weather. Describe a day in the life of a citizen living there.

prompt: Moto abandi komona bandɔtɔ na ye ya mabe na bomoi ya solosolo. Mbala nyonso oyo balamukaka, eteni mosusu ya mokili ya ndɔtɔ ya nsɔmɔ elandaka bango mpo na kokóma na makambo ya solo.
prompt_en: A person begins to experience their nightmares in real life. Every time they wake up, another piece of the nightmare world follows them into reality.

prompt: Banda kala, ba dragons esila, kasi moko ebotami lisusu na nzoto ya moto. Ndenge nini yango ezali na bopusi likoló na mokili ya maji?
prompt_en: Dragons have long been extinct, but one has been reborn into the body of a human. How does this affect the world of magic?

prompt: Kokoma na ntina ya engumba moko epai wapi, moko na moko, bato bazali kolimwa kozanga elembo. Ba oyo batikali bazali na souvenir te ya ba oyo bazangi.
prompt_en: Write about a town where, one by one, people are vanishing without a trace. Those who remain have no memory of the missing.

prompt: Na mokili oyo bandoto ekoki kokambama na kolandáká mimeseno ya sikisiki, limbolá ndenge moto amibongisaki mpo na ndɔtɔ na ye ya kokoka.
prompt_en: In a world where dreams can be controlled by following specific routines, describe a person’s preparation for their perfect dream.

prompt: Koma na ntina ya moto oyo asali boyokani na ekelamu moko ya maji mpo na kokangama na mikano na bango ya bokolongono. Mokolo nyonso oyo bazali koleka mosala moko, bakutanaka na mbuma moko ya kokamwa kasi oyo ezali malamu te.
prompt_en: Write about someone who makes a deal with a magical being to stick to their health goals. Each day they skip a task, they face a quirky but inconvenient consequence.

prompt: Salá bokoti ya zulunalo uta na mopanzi-nsango moko ya mambi ya kala oyo ayebani mingi oyo abɛti libaku na mabele oyo ezali te na karte moko te.
prompt_en: Create a journal entry from a famous historical explorer who stumbles upon a land that doesn’t exist on any map.

prompt: Ezali boni soki bato babandaki mibange na nsima, bakómaki bilenge ntango bazali na bomoi molai? Ndenge nini yango ekozala na bopusi likoló na boyokani na bango mpe likanisi ya ntango?
prompt_en: What if people started aging backwards, getting younger as they live longer? How would this affect their relationships and the concept of time?

prompt: Owuti kobanda mosala ya sika pe olingi omilakisa na ba membres ya équipe na yo. Koma email ya mibeko mpo na komilakisa mpe kolakisa esengo na yo mpo na kosala elongo.
prompt_en: You’ve just started a new job and want to introduce yourself to your team members. Write a formal email introducing yourself and expressing your excitement about working together.

prompt: Mbala nyonso oyo ozali kosukola bilamba, chaussette moko ezangaka, kasi na esika elimwa, etambolaka na boumeli ya ntango. Kokoma na ntina ya bokutani oyo yango ememaka na.
prompt_en: Every time you do the laundry, a sock goes missing, but instead of disappearing, it travels through time. Write about the discoveries this leads to.

prompt: Etuluku moko ya baninga babɛti libaku na buku moko ya kala oyo elobeli molulu moko ya kobenga nzambe oyo babosani. Basalaka yango lokola maseki —kino ekosimba.
prompt_en: A group of friends stumbles upon an old book that describes a ritual to summon a forgotten deity. They perform it as a joke—until it works.

prompt: Composer email informel kobengisa baninga na fête oyo ozali ko accueillir. Tyá makambo mosusu oyo etali dati, ngonga, esika, mpe misala nyonso ya sipesiale.
prompt_en: Compose an informal email inviting friends to a party you’re hosting. Include details about the date, time, location, and any special activities.
